requirements_summary: Workload: multi-turn chat agent with doc-search fallback and periodic summarization of long threads.
Latency target: p95 < 400ms for short messages (<=250 tokens); current EU p95 ~700-900ms when routed outside region.
Throughput: low-medium with bursts (30-150 concurrent users during business hours).
Cost sensitivity: tight SMB budget, goal under $10k ARR initially.
Model preferences: prefer smaller low-latency model for day-to-day chat; larger model acceptable for summaries on demand.
Routing/fallback needs: simple region pinning and fallback to smaller model during load; prefer managed routing over client complexity.
Security/compliance: SAML SSO required; audit logs needed; retention settings default acceptable for now.
perf_tuning_discussion: Region choice: strongly recommend enabling eu-west regional endpoint and pinning EU traffic to that endpoint to reduce network RTT.
Timeout settings: suggest client-side timeout for chat short-turns at 2.0-2.5s with 1-2 retries using exponential backoff; allow longer server-side timeout (8-12s) for summarization jobs.
Prompt length guidance: keep system+input <= 600-800 tokens for fast responses; truncate older turns using relevance or token-budget heuristics.
Batching guidance: disable batching for interactive chat; enable micro-batching only for background embedding or rerank jobs with window 50-100ms.
Caching: use prefix caching for static system prompts and store embeddings with 24-72h TTL depending on content freshness.
Model routing: recommend defaulting to a small, quantized chat model for interactive flows and routing to larger model via explicit route for summaries.
